biographical_milestones.historical_context: Marriage under active Rahu-Saturn (Saturn ruling 7th House Capricorn).

biographical_milestones.event: Sworn in as Prime Minister of India
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Ascended to Prime Ministership during Jupiter-Sun (Jupiter 9th Lord of Fortune, Sun 2nd Lord in 5th of Authority).
Declared Emergency during Saturn-Mercury (Saturn 8th Lord of crisis/transformation).
Electoral defeat during Saturn-Ketu (Ketu in 12th House of fall and isolation).
Landslide election victory under Saturn-Venus (Venus in 6th house of overcoming adversaries).
Assassinated by bodyguards under Saturn-Rahu (Saturn 7th Maraka Lord, Rahu in 6th of violence aspected by Mars).
